name: Loyal Solutions A/S
summary: Loyal Solutions A/S engages in the development, implementation, and operation of SaaS loyalty solutions based on payment/card-linked technology worldwide. It offers LoyalTfacts, a SaaS platform. The company provides solutions for loyalty, financial, airlines, malls, hospitality, telecom, security, and technology industries. Loyal Solutions A/S was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
